description: This file defines the AWSAgentCoreProcessor class, a Python module implementing a processor that interacts with Amazon Bedrock AgentCore Runtime to invoke agents and stream responses as LLMTextFrames. It includes transformers for request payload creation and response parsing, manages asynchronous response streaming, and handles frame processing within a larger pipeline.

classes.name: AWSAgentCoreProcessor
classes.description: A processor class that invokes Amazon Bedrock AgentCore agents, streams responses, and manages response framing within an asynchronous processing pipeline.

methods.name: default_context_to_payload_transformer
methods.description: Transforms LLM context into a JSON payload string for AgentCore, extracting the latest user or system message content.

methods.name: default_response_to_output_transformer
methods.description: Extracts the 'response' text from a JSON response line from AgentCore.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the AWSAgentCoreProcessor with AWS credentials, agent ARN, and optional transformers.

methods.name: _close_output_response_after_timeout
methods.description: Closes the output response frame after a timeout if no new text frames arrive.

methods.name: _push_text_frame
methods.description: Pushes a text frame, managing start and end frames for the response stream.

methods.name: process_frame
methods.description: Processes incoming frames, invokes the AgentCore agent asynchronously, and handles streaming responses.
